nom: ROSEN Break-Out Clearing Cleanser for Acne Prone Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (some with concurrent PCOS-related acne and rosacea) report the cleanser calms irritation and reduces breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, acne-prone skin report visible improvement within a week, though one reviewer warns against use if sensitive to the included botanicals due to a burning sensation.

concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness, rosacea or stress-related red acne report the cleanser calms and reduces redness quickly, sometimes within one or two washes.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with hormonal or PCOS-related acne on the chin and jawline report noticeable clearing over one to two weeks; one reviewer notes a burning sensation despite good results.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with adult or hormonal acne, including cystic and stress-triggered breakouts, report fast reduction in breakouts and congestion; no reviewer reports new breakouts, though one describes a burning sensation on application.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mention the cleanser helps manage oiliness alongside acne, but this is mentioned only incidentally, not as a primary focus.

aspects.libelle: Burning or stinging sensation on application
Bottle size too small for fast usage

extraits.texte: this sometimes burns when i use it, maybe due to the peppermint. But it works…very well. i breakout often due to a hormonal disorder, and i use this once or twice a day, but don't use the "quarter-sized" amount they suggest because of the burning sensation. I prefer the green cleanser Rosen makes, but that also has its own issues, so i might use both interchangeably. Both have a simple list of ingredients, which is my preference. despite their cons, i would reccomend this product or their other cleanser AS LONG AS you don't have known sensitivity to some of the botanicals they include.

I'm surprised at how well this has worked. I'm in my 30s and I feel like I have been struggling with acne forever, especially on my chin and jawline. I have PCOS, and I felt like my acne was getting worse. I bought this blindly since there were no reviews yet, but I was desperate. I use the Good Molecules Pineapple Scrub (powdery scrub) first to get the gunk off my face, then I use Rosen cleanser. I haven't had a reaction using the products together and it's been about 2 weeks. The acne on my jawline has really improved and so has my chin! I use the Rosen about every other day so I don't over do it, but it has helped so much. I'm sure if I used it day and night, my skin would be clearer. My only complaint is I wish the bottle was bigger because I know I'm going through it fast, and that's with every other day use. I'm happy I finally found something that might just help with the annoying acne!

If your skin is helped, soothed or cleared by using creams like Laroche Posay cicaplast B5 Baume then get this. I have adult acne, pcos, struggle with foliculitis due to the pcos facial hair growth☹, scarring, oily skin etc and this is changing things! The cleanser has a kinda weird texture, won't suds up but does clean, and I noticed the calming immediately, even more after a couple days. I'm using it at least once per day. It is going fast because the instructions say use a quarter size amount and I do but it's worth it. I have a lot of other cleansers but I'm using this consistently because the results are shockingly fast and great.

extraits.titre: I will be buying this product for the foreseeable future
extraits.texte: Never written a review for any skincare product but I feel like this literally does clear my acne quickly; even stubborn acne I get in the same spots (painful, red, probably stress acne) it seems to greatly reduce even in just 1 or 2 washes. I like how it foams and how it smells minty even though all the ingredients are natural which just makes it even better. 100/10
Holy grail! If you have sensitive acne prone skin this face wash is a must! You will literally see a difference within the first week!

If you have adult acne (pcos especially), congestion, rosacia, redness, oily, irritated skin you should try this. It smells like peppermint. It has a very different texture than other cleansers and feels kinda like a creamy paste (not sticky or stiff) so it'snot a bubbly soapy kind of cleanser. It's packed with zinc and reminds me so much of the LP cica Baume cream. It REALLLLY calms skin down and stops acne in its tracks to a fast, shocking degree. It seems to heal and repair while preventing acne and makes a huge difference. I am a regular user and buyer and pray they never stop making this.
Best face wash ever ! I have sensitive acne prone skin and this has face wash is magical! You can see a difference within a week.

reserve: The sample is small (8 reviews) and skews strongly positive, with only one critical review, so conclusions about dissent or broader skin types remain limited.
